title: Stakeholder experiences in a model project (§64b Social code book (SGB) V) with the goal to improve psychiatric care in the Palatinate region
summary: Interview-based study of the perception of a model project to improve psychiatric care in the Palatinate region (Germany) for those affected, relatives and outpatient services

interventions.name: Patients and relatives are surveyed using key question-based interviews at three survey times (2021, 2023/2024, 2026). A new sample is drawn at each survey time (trend study).
Outpatient actors are surveyed using key question-based interviews at three survey times (2021, 2023/2024, 2026). A new sample is drawn at each survey time (trend study).
Former patients will be surveyed once in 2021 using key question-based interviews

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1st arm: patients
1) Currently treated patient  (inpatient, partial inpatient or outpatient treatment) at the time of recruitment
2) Place of residence within the catchment area
3) Readiness for questioning 

2nd arm: outpatient stakeholders
General criteria (obligatory)
1) Readiness for questioning 
General criteria (either)
1) Direct or indirect role in recovery or (re) integration of patients in their social environment (e.g. employer)
2) Authority or institution interacting with patients, whereby psychological limitations are relevant (e.g. schools, employment offices)
3) Facilities or services that are directly involved in the care of people with mental illnesses (e.g. nursing homes and services, social psychiatric service)
4) Formal and informal groups whose main purpose is to promote and maintain the mental health of individuals or the general public
5) Groups or individuals who have a direct or indirect personal role in maintaining the health or (re)integrating patients with mental illnesses (e.g. local health politicians and foundations)
6) Resident general practitioner or specialist with, involved in the treatment of psychiatric patients directly or indirectly

Special criteria for informal groups:
1) For self-help groups and comparable associations: Association status or public appearance (social media, flyers) as a group with general accessibility


3rd arm: Former patients
1) No treatment at the Pfalzklinikum for 9 months
2) No more than three years without treatment
3) Readiness for questioning
Exclusion criteria:
1st arm:

Psychiatry (PPP)
1) The person is mentally incapable of participating in an interview (e.g. due to advanced dementia or acute psychosis).
2) Person does not have sufficient knowledge of the German language
3) Person has already been participated in the study in an alternative role as a relative or a parent

Child and Adolescent Psychiatry (KJP)
1) A child or adolescent is mentally incapable of participating in an interview (e.g. due to a specific disability).
2) Adolescent (16 years or older) does not have sufficient knowledge of the German language
3) Caretakers of an adolescent or child under 16 years don't have sufficient knowledge of the German language
4) Child is under 4 years old

Gerontopsychiatry (GPP):
1) Depression or mild dementia: Based on the files or staff assessments, it cannot be assumed that a person is capable of participating in an interview (e.g., due to a specific disability) or does not   have sufficient language skills for the interview situation.
2) Severe dementia: The patient's relatives cannot be assumed to have a sufficient understanding of the German language.


2nd arm: Outpatient stakeholders
No explicit exclusion criteria in addition to not meeting specified inclusion criteria.

3rd arm: Former patients
No explicit exclusion criteria in addition to not meeting specified inclusion criteria.
